notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Lore Broker.
Lore Broker does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Lore Broker by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and create a Treasure artifact token for each opponent you have, then causing each player to discard a card.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Lore Broker.
Repeat.
If you have two or more opponents, this combo nets near-infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.
